now-sdk download <directory>

Download application metadata from instance.

Parameters:
  directory  Path to expand application                      [string] [required]

Options:
  -d, --debug        Print debug output               [boolean] [default: false]
      --source       Path to the directory that contains package.json
                     configuration
  [string] [default: "/work/projects/my-app/.claude/worktree
                                                            s/sdk-panel-22ceb0"]
      --incremental  Download application metadata from the instance in
                     incremental mode                 [boolean] [default: false]
      --timeout      Maximum time, in seconds, to wait for the instance to
                     respond during the download before giving up
                                                        [number] [default: 3600]
  -h, --help         Show help                                         [boolean]
  -v, --version      Show version number                               [boolean]
